title: Full Moon in Capricorn
tldr: A culmination and release point for the Capricorn / Cancer axis.
theme: This Full Moon illuminates structure, ambition, responsibility, boundaries, time, and the legacy built through real effort through the Capricorn side of the axis, while the Sun in Cancer asks for integration rather than extremes.
shadow: achievement at the cost of humanity, measuring worth only by output, or choosing success over softness
integration: building something durable without abandoning the life it is meant to support

twoWeekArc.teaching: This arc shows where protection became a wall instead of a home.
twoWeekArc.appPrompt: Name what the last two weeks revealed. Release the pattern that blocks the Capricorn / Cancer balance point.

sixMonthArc.appPrompt: Look back to the same-sign New Moon. What took root because you tended it, and what grew because the soil was left untended?

ritual.function: illumination, release, cleansing, integration, and completion
ritual.timing: Use after the exact Full Moon when possible. Keep eclipse lunations under the separate witness protocol, not ordinary release ritual.
ritual.materials: Saturn kamea, black tourmaline, salt, elm, oil lantern or candle, and water.
ritual.simpleSubstitution: A white candle, water, paper, and a quiet place are enough.
ritual.action: Write what is complete, what is ready to be released, and how the higher expression of Capricorn can be embodied without rejecting Cancer.

journalPrompt: What am I ready to release from the shadow of Capricorn, and what balance with Cancer is asking to be lived now?
tarotPrompt: What truth is this Capricorn Full Moon revealing that I can no longer avoid?
